questions.prompt: Which part is the control centre of the cell?
questions.explanation: The nucleus controls the cell and holds the hereditary information. The membrane controls only what goes in and out.

questions.prompt: Which part controls what enters and leaves the cell?
questions.explanation: The cell membrane is selectively permeable. The cytoplasm is the jelly-like substance inside.

questions.prompt: In which organelles does the cell release energy?
questions.explanation: Cellular respiration takes place in the mitochondria. The nucleus is the control centre and does not release energy.

questions.prompt: Why do muscle cells have many mitochondria?
options: Muscle cells need a lot of energy
Muscle cells store a lot of water
Muscle cells make food from sunlight
questions.explanation: Muscles do a lot of work, so their cells need many mitochondria to release energy.

options: A jelly-like substance in which reactions take place
questions.explanation: The cytoplasm fills the cell and holds the organelles. The hereditary information is in the nucleus.

questions.prompt: 'Selectively permeable' means that the cell membrane...
options: lets some substances pass and stops others
questions.explanation: Selective means it chooses. Some substances pass through and others are kept in or out.
